newsitem.title: KUWAIT: Kuwait reports shooting on border with Iraq.
newsitem.headline: Kuwait reports shooting on border with Iraq.

text.p: Kuwait said on Tuesday its border guards exchanged fire with gunmen on the Iraqi side on the Iraq-Kuwait border after a Kuwaiti border observation post came under attack.
"The shooting took place at dawn on Sunday," Colonel Badr Saleh of the interior ministry told Reuters by telephone. "They were about four gunmen and a driver," he added.
"They opened fire at a border observation post and the Kuwaiti police had to return fire," he said, adding that the shooting lasted for about 30 minutes at al-Abdali border area.
Saleh said the ministry informed the United Nations Iraq-Kuwait Observation Mission (UNIKOM) of the incident.
A UNIKOM official said a Kuwaiti report about a shooting was being investigated. He did not give further details.
Saleh said there were no injuries on the Kuwait side.
